required_forms.where_to_get: At the home branch of deceased
required_forms.notes: Must be filled by the nominee in the presence of bank officer
Required along with nominee claim form

required_documents.condition: Required only if no nominee is registered on the account
Required if claim is disputed or no nominee and no legal heir cert

procedure_steps: Visit the home branch of the deceased — the branch where the account was held
Carry all original documents and self-attested copies
Meet the branch manager and inform about the death claim
Collect and fill the nominee claim form and account closure form at the branch
Submit all documents to the branch manager
Bank will verify the nomination records internally
Balance transferred directly to nominee's bank account via NEFT
common_rejection_reasons: Nominee not registered on account — legal heir cert required
Mismatch in nominee name vs Aadhaar

special_cases.no_nominee_registered: Legal heir certificate required from tehsil/municipality. All legal heirs must be present at branch.
special_cases.disputed_claim: Succession certificate from civil court required. Claim processing halted until resolved.
special_cases.pan_missing: Bank will reject claim. Apply for duplicate PAN at NSDL before initiating claim.
special_cases.joint_account: Surviving account holder can operate account directly. Death certificate required for KYC update.
